SPEC_TEXT: POST /api/vault/commit requires session auth and OWNER / SYSTEM RBAC.
The request contains metadata.created_by, timestamp and idempotency_key.
Audit Log = user/system actions with accountability.
AUTHORITY_CLASS: DOC-C BUILD SPEC / FINAL CANONICAL API + OBSERVABILITY CONTRACT
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: VAULT_COMMIT_CREATED immutable audit attribution must represent the authenticated actor/authority that actually performed the action.
Client-controlled request metadata may carry canonical created_by provenance but must not be able to forge immutable AuditLog.actor_id or role.
Role authority must come from authenticated session/system context, not from request-body metadata.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not use untrusted metadata.created_by as the authoritative immutable audit actor without binding it to authenticated identity.
Do not allow a successful vault commit whose immutable audit actor can be chosen independently of the authenticated principal.

EVIDENCE.observation: authorizeReadContext yields authenticated userId/role, but handleVaultCommit passes metadata.created_by as commitVault.authorId; commitVault uses authorId as AuditLog.actor and chain input.
